-- in --
package main

templ test() {
	<p><span>a</span><span class="x">Formatting must never change what a template renders, so a glued boundary may only break inside of the next opening tag.</span></p>
}
-- out --
package main

templ test() {
	<p>
		<span>a</span><span
			class="x"
		>
			Formatting must never change what a template renders, so a glued boundary may only break
			inside of the next opening tag.
		</span>
	</p>
}
